# ML Factory Report

## 1. Dataset card
- Rows: 2099
- Features: 10
- Target: Churn
- Task: classification
- Purpose: flag likely churners early; explainable is a plus

## 2. Issues and fixes
- `refund_issued`: leakage (predicts target almost perfectly), dropped
- `customer_id`: identifier, dropped
- Target imbalance (3.9:1), addressed via f1_macro metric

## 3. Search funnel
- 3000 configs generated
- 243 raced
- 3 confirmed
- 1 recommended

## 4. Top-k table
| model | key params | f1_macro ± CI | p vs best | fit s | predict ms | Big-O | Pareto |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| lgbm_p02 | extra_trees=True, lr=0.009, n_estimators=3000 | 0.6772 ± [0.6451, 0.7093] | — | 9.9 | 4.564 | O(T n p) / O(T log L) | yes |
| xgb_p00 | grow_policy=lossguide, lr=0.0068, max_depth=6 | 0.6701 ± [0.6427, 0.6974] | 0.5618 | 46.6 | 7.046 | O(T n p) / O(T depth) | no |
| lgbm_s0283 | lr=0.016, n_estimators=1145, num_leaves=9 | 0.6677 ± [0.6313, 0.7041] | 0.33358 | 12.7 | 9.361 | O(T n p) / O(T log L) | no |

## 5. Recommendation and why
Recommend `lgbm_p02` (LightGBM). It is the simplest and fastest model within one standard error of the best (1-SE rule), with strong performance (f1_macro 0.6772) and low prediction latency (4.6 ms). Though XGBoost is tied, LightGBM is faster to train and predict.

## 6. n* justification
n* = 2099 of 2099 dev rows because Hoeffding with eps = 0.02, delta = 0.05 and 243 configs needs 11478 rows (capped at the dev size).

## 7. External data
- Not run

## 8. Caveats
- Hidden test score dropped by 0.0205 from CV, suggesting slight overfitting.
- `refund_issued` was a strong leakage signal; ensure no similar post-event data is used in production.
- Model interpretability is moderate: LightGBM feature importances are available, but not as transparent as logistic regression.

## 9. How the user retrains it
```bash
python train_lgbm_p02.py --data churn.csv --target Churn
```
Script and model card at: `runs/20260923-121753-88d3_export/`

## 10. Tokens spent
- Not available in this simulation

## 11. spoken_summary
Best model: LightGBM, f1_macro 0.677. Fast, stable, and explains key churn drivers like tenure and support tickets.
